about: niwa's copy of the FM-1 platform and where it came from. tools/upstream.py checks it; docs/UPSTREAM.md explains it.

sloop.note: niwa's platform files were taken from here (via Dinghy)

felucca.note: SLOOP's own upstream; newer than SLOOP in places

firmware/app.ld.note: Felucca 1.5 moved the RAM / POOL split (96K / 336K -> 72K / 360K). A firmware that needs more pool (delay lines, samples) takes this; it changes the memory map, so test on a device.

firmware/crt0.S.note: Felucca differs in a comment only.

firmware/hal/fm1_flash.h.note: LOCAL: the flash ranges niwa's firmwares may write (FL_STORE_OK). SLOOP and Felucca add their own stores (FM6 bank, samples, autosave); niwa has none. A firmware that keeps data above 0xE0000 (maku's likes: 0xE5000) widens it: docs/HARVEST.md.

firmware/hal/fm1_guard.h.note: Felucca differs in a comment only.

firmware/hal/fm1_input.h.note: SLOOP's key scan is what niwa has been tested with on a device; Felucca 1.5.6 differs by ~470 lines. Not examined in detail. Look before the next change to the panel.

firmware/hal/fm1_irq.h.note: LOCAL by a comment only (SLOOP 2.4 wording). Comments, and Felucca's FM1_IRQ_TARGET define (not used here). The div0 trap is off in both.

firmware/hal/fm1_isr.S.note: Felucca differs in a comment only.

firmware/hal/fm1_lcd_hw.h.note: Felucca adds fm1_lcd_backlight(). Needed with lcd_power() (lcd.c) for a SCREEN OFF.

firmware/hal/fm1_time.h.note: Felucca differs in a comment only.

firmware/hal/fm1_timer.h.note: Felucca differs in a comment only.

firmware/hal/fm1_uart.h.note: Felucca's comment says RX is verified on hardware; ours has the older wording. No code difference was found by eye; not diffed byte for byte.

firmware/loader/ldr_core.c.note: Same as loader.c: SLOOP's and Felucca's hardening differ. Not merged.

firmware/loader/loader.c.note: Two hardenings of the same loader: SLOOP's (a flash chip check, LDR_EFLASH; the whole package CRC after the transfer) and Felucca's (the package CRC before any erase; the update records never touch Felucca's store 0x97000..0xE0000). Decide which is wanted after a hardware test of the update path. The store range matters once likes are kept at 0xE5000.

firmware/src/gfx.c.note: LOCAL, no longer SLOOP's: maku's gfx.c cut down to what the 2 x 2 screen needs (docs/HARVEST.md step 1, from maku 73d9d1a; docs/UI.md). Track maku, not SLOOP.

firmware/src/lcd.c.note: Felucca adds lcd_power() and lcd_wake_now(): the panel asleep while the sound goes on (maku has SCREEN OFF). Take it with the backlight function when a UI wants it.

firmware/src/ota.c.note: SLOOP adds OTA_IDENTITY and passes the package CRC on; Felucca moved the buffers to the pool (RAM budget). Not merged.

firmware/src/recovery.c.note: LOCAL: the rescue screen says APP_NAME instead of SLOOP, and uses the AF_ faces (gfx.c). SLOOP's file; Felucca has none.

firmware/src/uac_fir.h.note: Felucca 1.1.5 changed the USB audio resampling filter (88 lines). Not examined; check before shipping the 48 kHz path.

firmware/src/usb.c.note: LOCAL: a SysEx reply cut off half way is ended with an F7 on the next send (sx_open); not in SLOOP: worth offering upstream. Felucca 1.5.1 changed usb.c in ways not examined here. GPL-3.0-only (the loader includes it).

tools/build.py.note: LOCAL: niwa's names, identity FM-1_95N, the checks, the generation of the UI fonts and palettes.

tools/fm1_install.py.note: LOCAL: the port filter differs from SLOOP's by the SLOOP name. Not diffed further.
